prompt:
After an OTA update, CarService crashes right after boot on head units that have a Wi-Fi module, and the car comes up with no audio or display. Head units without Wi-Fi boot fine. The crash from logcat:
E AndroidRuntime: FATAL EXCEPTION: CarServiceMain
E AndroidRuntime: Process: com.android.car, PID: 1432
E AndroidRuntime: java.lang.NullPointerException: Attempt to invoke virtual method 'void com.android.car.power.Mgr2.set(boolean)' on a null object reference
E AndroidRuntime: 	at com.android.car.power.Mgr5.doIt8(Mgr5.java:42)
E AndroidRuntime: 	at com.android.car.power.Mgr5.doIt1(Mgr5.java:34)
E AndroidRuntime: 	at com.android.car.power.Mgr1.doIt2(Mgr1.java:25)
E AndroidRuntime: 	at com.android.car.power.Mgr1.doIt7(Mgr1.java:16)
Find the fault in packages/services/Car. Answer with the file and the function that contain it, and one sentence on why. Do not change any file.
reference_answer: packages/services/Car/service/src/com/android/car/power/Mgr5.java, doIt8: the fault of loc-aosp-power-policy (obfuscated names, comments stripped).
